notablePrerequisites:
You control artifact creatures that can tap to add at least {2}.
Lita is not your commander.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Lita triggers.
In response, activate artifact creatures by tapping them to add at least {2}.
Continuing to hold priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Lita's triggered ability.
Resolve the copied ability, untapping all artifact creatures you control.
Repeat from step 2.
